name: Severe Weather Warning
description: One active/expired severe-weather heads-up for a watch location, produced by the hourly evaluator. headline/message are the exact end-user strings (heads-up possibility phrasing only - never official warning taxonomy); precursors is admin/debug detail and is never sent to clients. All datetimes are UTC.

fields.label: Event Class
fields.options:
flash_flood
flood
destructive_wind
tornado
cold_front
upstream_flood
fields.description: cold_front is the informational cool-change class (warnings_engine/cold_front.py) - always severity advisory, never pushed. upstream_flood is the basin-routed river-rise class (warnings_engine/basin.py) - raised from rain over the cell's upstream catchment, never by the frozen detector

fields.label: Severity (internal enum)
fields.description: Machine identifier only - clients render the wording-based label/strings, never this value. advisory (neighbor-propagated soft notice) is strictly below heads_up in prominence; clients that do not know it must render nothing

fields.label: Detector Tier
fields.description: Frozen detector tier at the last evaluation (2 warning, 3 severe). Admin visibility only - duplicated out of precursors so the desk list view / report builder can show and filter it. Never sent to clients.

fields.label: Confidence
fields.description: Detector confidence (0-1) at the last evaluation. Admin visibility only - duplicated out of precursors for list/report use. Never sent to clients.

fields.label: Onset (UTC)
fields.description: First hour the detector episode fired

fields.label: Last Pushed Severity (internal)
fields.description: Highest internal severity already push-notified for this episode - empty means no push yet. Refreshes at or below this level never push again; an escalation above it pushes immediately.

fields.label: Last Pushed At (UTC)
fields.description: When the last push notification for this record went out - drives the per-(location, class) cooldown

fields.label: Drill
fields.description: 1 = training-exercise record written by the drill replay runner (warnings_engine/drill.py). Drill records are admin-visible only: excluded from push notifications, from the outcome ledger, from the CAP feed's Actual alerts and from client responses unless a drill flag is explicitly requested. Fail-closed everywhere - a drill can never reach a real end user.

fields.label: Drill Run ID
fields.description: Identifier of the drill replay run that wrote this record (empty on real records) - lets one exercise be inspected and cleared as a unit (api/clear_drill).

fields.label: Precursors (admin only)
fields.description: JSON: fired detector conditions, confidence, tier, data horizon, source, config sha256. Never sent to clients.
